from scipy.optimize import least_squares
L=np.log(1+t)**2/P
def build(a):
    return np.column_stack([t,np.sin(a*t)/P,L])
def resid(p):
    X=build(p[0]); c=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dP_dt,rcond=None)[0]
    return X@c-dP_dt
best=None
for a0 in np.linspace(0.1,3,30):
    r=least_squares(resid,[a0])
    if best is None or r.cost<best.cost: best=r
print(best.x,best.cost)
X=build(best.x[0]); c=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dP_dt,rcond=None)[0]
res=dP_dt-X@c
print(c)
print(np.round(np.polyfit(t,res,3),3), np.round(np.polyfit(P,res,3),3))
print(np.round(np.corrcoef(np.column_stack([res,t,P,t*P,P**2,np.exp(-t),t**2,1/P,t/P]).T)[0],3))
